loader_handoff.basis: Declared discovery input: an all-zero loader handoff in a free RAM gap, not a capture. The registered map of X-E3 1.32 copy B (stream-035426a8) is a single section at 0xb51000-0xff16ec and the application stream begins at 0x1417000, so nothing in the registered map occupies 0x900000-0x9005c0. The 0x5c0 extent is the shared X-Processor Pro handoff size declared by xt2-discovery and gfx50r-discovery; this body's own kernel copy of it has not been located, so the extent is assumed from the generation rather than read. Kernel entry bypasses the boot ROM. Copy A (stream-00230268) differs in content from copy B and is not the copy that runs on the camera.

flash_aperture.basis: Declared discovery input: the update image from its flash offset; bytes past it read erased. No flash capture exists.
